input.quote: Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the \"Termination Date\").
input.rationale: Section 4 addresses term, termination notice and the Termination Payment only; there is no effects-of-termination, transition-assistance, data export/return or deletion provision anywhere in the Agreement (Sections 1.4/1.5 give access and export files only during the term, and Section 8 confidentiality does not require return of our Content or customer data). In a hosting arrangement where HDI holds the Site, our Content and customer/user data on its own server, the absence of any exit mechanic fails even the fallback position, so we insert a short clause at the fallback level: at least 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days after expiry or termination. We have not pressed the preferred six-month/certified-deletion package.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data export clause
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit provision, so we would lose our Site content and customer data on termination. We have added a short clause giving us at least 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days after expiry or termination, which is our fallback position.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) provide the Company with transition assistance for a period of at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination, and (b) export and deliver to the Company all Content, user information and other data of the Company within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
